question.text: Lyophilic sols are more stable than lyophobic sols because:

options.text: the colloidal particles have no charge.
the colloidal particles have positive charge.
there is a strong electrostatic repulsion between the negatively charged colloidal particles.

solution.text:
Lyophilic sols are quite stable and cannot be easily coagulated. Lyophobic sols need stabilising agents for their preservation.

Property Lyophilic colloids Lyophobic colloids
Stability These are very stable These are unstable and require traces of stabilizers
